responsibility: Builds and repairs RTL control-flow graphs from the instruction stream. It classifies RTL insns for basic-block boundaries, creates normal and EH edges from jumps/calls/landing pads, scans blocks for internal labels or control-flow insns that require splitting, purges dead jump-table and branch edges, and recomputes outgoing edge probabilities/counts after such restructuring. In practice this is the backend’s CFG-construction engine that turns linear RTL into basic blocks and keeps the CFG synchronized after expansion or coarse RTL edits.
same_name_distinction: Contains the RTL-specific logic that scans insn streams to form or repair basic blocks and edges, classifies control-flow insns, creates EH edges, splits sub-basic-blocks, and recomputes outgoing probabilities; unlike gcc/cfgbuild.h, which only publishes the small exported RTL CFG-building interface.
